title: Find customers who cancelled
prompt: Return the first_name and last_name of every customer who has at least one cancelled order, sorted by first_name. A customer appears once, however many orders they cancelled.
hints: The question is whether such an order exists, not how many there are.
EXISTS with a subquery that refers to the outer customer never repeats a row.
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'cancelled')

wrongAnswers.misconception: Joins to the orders, so a customer appears once per cancelled order.
Tests for any order and forgets the status.

feedback: Look for a name that appears twice, and for a customer whose orders were never cancelled.
